title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer to create user-friendly, visually appealing, and engaging digital experiences. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of user interface design, user experience principles, and modern design trends, with the ability to transform ideas into functional and attractive designs.

Key Responsibilities

* Design intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces for websites, mobile applications, and other digital platforms.
* Conduct user research and understand user requirements, behaviour, and expectations.
* Create wireframes, user flows, mockups, and interactive prototypes.
* Develop responsive designs that provide a seamless experience across different devices and screen sizes.
* Collaborate with developers, project managers, and creative teams to ensure effective design implementation.
* Maintain consistency in design elements, typography, colours, and branding guidelines.
* Improve existing designs based on user feedback and usability testing.
* Stay updated with the latest UI/UX trends, tools, and design technologies.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or relevant qualification in Design, Multimedia, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in UI/UX design.
* Proficiency in Figma and other relevant design tools.
* Strong knowledge of wireframing, prototyping, and user journey mapping.
* Understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles.
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and front-end development concepts is an advantage.
* Strong visual design, creativity, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.

Preferred Skills

* Experience in designing websites, dashboards, and mobile applications.
* Knowledge of design systems and component libraries.
* Understanding of usability standards and accessibility guidelines.
* Experience working in a digital marketing, advertising, or creative agency is an added advantage.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹22,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

1. Job Summary

Navera Builders Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a creative and technically skilled Interior Designer with experience in high-rise residential building projects. The candidate will be responsible for developing interior design concepts, preparing detailed drawings, creating realistic 3D visualizations, and coordinating with project teams to ensure quality execution of interior works in high-rise apartments and common areas.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
At Sioniq Tech Pvt Ltd, we specialize in delivering innovative ERP solutions tailored for the jewellery industry. Our products empower jewellery manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers by enhancing efficiency, usability, and digital transformation. We are seeking a skilled UI/UX Designer with over 5+ years of experience to join our creative team. If you have a strong design sense, technical understanding of web applications, and a passion for creating meaningful user experiences.

**Job Description:**

As a UI/UX Designer at Sioniq Tech, you will be responsible for designing intuitive and visually appealing interfaces for our ERP and web applications. You’ll work closely with the Development, Product, and Marketing teams to bridge the gap between design and technology, ensuring seamless user experiences. A working understanding of web application structures, design systems, and color variables will be essential for this role.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and enhance user interfaces for web and mobile applications with a focus on usability and aesthetics.
* Create wireframes, interactive prototypes, mockups, and high-fidelity designs.
* Collaborate with developers to ensure design accuracy and maintain consistency across web applications.
* Understand and apply web design principles, responsive layouts, and color variables (CSS/SCSS).
* Work with design systems and component libraries to maintain visual consistency.
* Contribute to UI improvements for dashboards, forms, and data-heavy ERP modules.
* Participate in user research and usability testing to refine design outcomes.
* Create visual assets, icons, and marketing-related graphics when needed.
* Stay current with emerging design trends, web technologies, and UX best practices.
* Mentor junior designers and collaborate in a team-oriented environment.

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of proven experience as a UI/UX Designer in web or software projects.
* Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch for UI/UX design and prototyping.
* Working knowledge of web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular basics).
* Understanding of color variables, design tokens, and responsive design concepts.
* Strong sense of visual hierarchy, layout design, color theory, and typography.
* Experience with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for graphics and visual design tasks.
* Familiarity with Design Thinking, User Research, and Usability Testing.
* Good understanding of web accessibility and interaction design principles.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

**Educational Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Design, Computer Science, Visual Communication, or a related field.
* A background in Graphic Design, Interaction Design, or Web Design is preferred.

The duties and responsibilities of an interior architect encompass a wide range of tasks aimed at designing and creating functional, aesthetically pleasing interior spaces. Some key responsibilities include:

**Client Consultation and Needs Assessment:** Interior architects work closely with clients to understand their requirements, preferences, and objectives for the interior space. They conduct initial consultations, site visits, and interviews to gather information about the project scope, budget, timeline, and design expectations.

**Space Planning and Layout Design:** Interior architects develop spatial layouts and floor plans that optimize the use of available space while meeting the functional needs of occupants. They consider factors such as traffic flow, circulation patterns, zoning regulations, accessibility requirements, and ergonomic considerations to create efficient and user-friendly interior environments.

**Concept Development and Design:** Interior architects conceptualize design ideas and develop creative concepts that reflect the client's vision, brand identity, and design goals. They create mood boards, sketches, renderings, and 3D models to communicate design concepts and present design proposals to clients for review and approval.

**Material Selection and Specification:** Interior architects select appropriate materials, finishes, furnishings, and fixtures that align with the design concept, budget, and performance requirements of the project. They research and evaluate materials for durability, sustainability, aesthetics, and compatibility with the overall design scheme.

**Coordination with Stakeholders:** Interior architects collaborate with architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, and other project stakeholders to coordinate the implementation of design plans and ensure seamless integration of architectural and interior elements. They review construction documents, participate in meetings, and address design-related issues to facilitate effective communication and project management.

**Construction Administration and Site Supervision:** Interior architects oversee the construction process, monitor progress, and ensure that design specifications are implemented according to plans and specifications. They conduct site visits, inspections, and quality checks to verify compliance with building codes, regulations, and industry standards.

**Project Management and Documentation:** Interior architects manage project timelines, budgets, and resources to ensure timely completion of deliverables within established parameters. They prepare project schedules, budgets, contracts, and other documentation, and maintain detailed records of project activities, correspondence, and changes for reference and accountability.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Interior Architecture or Interior Designing
* **Technical Proficiency:** Mastery of CAD, 3D modeling, and rendering software (AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, 3Ds Max).
* **Industry Knowledge:** Strong grasp of building materials, construction methods, lighting design, and sustainability.
* **Soft Skills:** Project management, clear communication, collaborative problem-solving, and client relationship management , Leadership & Creativity
